description: Gift Agumon in a cage at the start, next to the starter DigiEgg. ARM9 function 0x02060f68 (called when a new game is set up) created only the egg (species 0) and added it to the 16-slot Digimon pool. Its body is rewritten (the original was mostly an unrolled struct copy) to loop twice: the egg exactly as before (fields +0x148=0xe, position 0x80,0x78), then Agumon (species 0x22 = name index 26 + 8) with default fields. Found with Ghidra.

patches.comment: new body of FUN_02060f68 after its prologue: create egg + Agumon with FUN_020618e8, add each with FUN_020613a0 to the pool at *(0x02112478+4)
